verdicts_or_reports.expected: Restoring big.jpg returns it to the original IrisSeed album, showing one album with two items.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: After trashing and restoring big.jpg, two IrisSeed cards each show 1 items. Opening the original shows only huge.jpg. The split persists after revisiting and rotation.
steps: Open IrisSeed containing big.jpg and huge.jpg.
Open big.jpg and Delete (moves to Trash).
Open Library > Trash > big.jpg > Restore selected.
Return to Albums: two IrisSeed cards appear, each with 1 items.
Open original IrisSeed, rotate and return: split remains.

verdicts_or_reports.expected: The chosen Photos or Videos filter remains selected after leaving and reopening the app.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: Selecting Photos, exiting with Back and reopening resets to Media. Reproduced with Videos as well.
steps: In Media open Filter and select Photos.
Press Back to exit the app, then reopen it. Observe Media selected.
Repeat selecting Videos, exit with Back and reopen. Media selected again.

verdicts_or_reports.observed: The album count reads '1 items'. Repeated after returning to Albums and reopening the app.
steps: Open IrisSeed and move big.jpg to Trash, leaving huge.jpg.
Return to Albums and read the IrisSeed count.
Leave and return; the singular count still says 1 items.
